visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Focus is invisible
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Keyboard users cannot see which field is active. The page removes the focus outline and has no other style for the focused field.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
<style>
  input { border: 2px solid silver; }
  input:focus { outline: none; }
</style>
<input id="mail" placeholder="Email">

solution.code:
<style>
  input { border: 2px solid silver; }
  input:focus { border-color: orange; outline: 2px solid orange; }
</style>
<input id="mail" placeholder="Email">
solution.explanation: A focus outline is the only sign for keyboard and screen magnifier users of where they are. If you remove it, you must replace it with another clear style on :focus.

checks.label: Focusing the field changes how it looks
checks.expr: (() => { var before = style('#mail', 'borderTopColor') + style('#mail', 'outlineStyle'); el('#mail').focus(); return before !== style('#mail', 'borderTopColor') + style('#mail', 'outlineStyle'); })()
